s.note: Cornmeal cakes griddled hot by the fire with butter and honey, the ones Meeko raids first.
s.how: Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt, then stir in the milk, egg and half the melted butter to a thick batter. Fry spoonfuls in a hot buttered pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden. Serve hot with butter and honey.

s.note: Maple-roasted pecans and walnuts, a harvest handful from the willow's roots.
s.how: Toss 100g pecans, 100g walnuts and 50g pepitas with 4 tbsp maple syrup and a pinch of sea salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 12 minutes, stirring once. Leave to cool completely so they set, then break into rough clusters.

m.note: Turkey thighs, pumpkin, corn, kidney beans and tomato, stewed thick with sage.
m.how: Brown 600g diced turkey thighs, then add 500g diced butternut pumpkin, a can of corn, a can of drained kidney beans, a can of crushed tomatoes and a teaspoon of dried sage. Simmer 40 minutes until thick. Bake a quick cornbread from cornmeal, flour, egg and milk to serve alongside.

w.note: Peach halves roasted with butter and maple syrup.
w.how: Halve 4 ripe peaches and remove the stones. Sit cut side up in a baking dish, dot with butter and drizzle with maple syrup. Roast at 200C for 15 minutes until soft and syrupy. Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and crushed pecans on top.

d.note: Blueberries and fresh mint crushed with honey and cranberries, topped with cold creek water.
d.how: In a jug, muddle 125g blueberries with a handful of mint leaves, a handful of fresh cranberries and 2 tbsp honey until the berries burst. Stir in 500ml cranberry juice and chill for 30 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, pour in the berry mix to halfway and top with cold water. Garnish with fresh blueberries and a mint sprig.
